faqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqSection.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our service and how WhatsApp monitoring works.

items.q: Will the target know that their WhatsApp is being monitored?
items.a: Not at all. Our service uses high-level cloud bypass technology that runs in 100% Stealth Mode without notifications or signs on the target device.

items.q: Do I need to install an app on the target phone?
items.a: No. You only need an active target WhatsApp number to start the verification & monitoring process.

items.q: How long does the sync process take before data appears?
items.a: Initial synchronization usually takes less than 1 to 3 minutes depending on the target's message history size.

items.q: Can I view WhatsApp messages that have been deleted?
items.a: Yes! Our system automatically backs up chats in real-time, so messages deleted by target ("Delete for everyone") remain saved and readable.

items.q: What if I need technical assistance?
items.a: Our customer support team is ready 24/7 via the WhatsApp CS button in the bottom right corner of the page.
